capabilities: Create and edit mind maps stored as .smm.md Markdown files
Switch between mind map and outline editing modes
Embed mind map previews in Markdown notes via ![[]] images
Link nodes to Obsidian files and other notes with internal links
Import and export smm, json, xmind, png, svg, and pdf files
extras: Freemium: some features (professional version) require a separate purchase from Pkmer, and pro licenses are not shared between the plugin and the standalone client. The marketplace version omits XMind/Docx import-export because of Obsidian marketplace review limits; the full version must be downloaded manually. The plugin source is not open source, only the underlying mind-map library is. The README warns the plugin is PC-first and incomplete on mobile, and that some UI theme colors do not follow the Obsidian theme.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in mind mapping tool, so users must leave the vault for external mind map apps and lose internal links.

relations.evidence: 本项目底层基于开源项目 mind-map

summary: Mind map editor that stores maps as .smm.md Markdown files, with themes, outline mode, Obsidian internal links, image embedding, and import/export.
